[quote=ereneoic;60827045][spoiler=interfaith outreach][b]Interfaith Committee of the EOIC[/b]

[u]Proposal for Dialogue Between EOIC States and Other Religiously-Focused States[/u]

[i]بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم[/i]

A common problem among people of all religions is a lack of exposure to other religious beliefs and people of other religions. This isnt necessarily always bad, but it does create the possibility for stereotypes, biases, and prejudice to impact how different religious groups see each other. Taken to an extreme, this can and does lead to communal violence and discrimination in some cases. 

In Baladullah, discrimination against non-Muslims had been a significant problem until the 1980s, as it was promoted by the Arabist Wahhabi dictatorship of 1956-1978, and before that hadnt been truly addressed in any meaningful way. However, following the implementation of the 1981 Constitution, major steps were taken to rectify the problems of the past and create a more inclusive and accepting society. Laws banning religious discrimination, providing reparations to non-Muslim communities, and establishing an affirmative action program as well as seats guaranteed in the Grand Majlisi for non-Muslim members were all implemented in the 1980s. Dialogue and discussion groups were promoted by the government at all schools and universities, and hate speech laws were introduced as well.

Today, while our country isnt a utopia by any means, there is a far better relationship between Muslims and non-Muslims, as well as between Sunni and Shia Muslims. This has only been possible through the participation of the broad masses of people of all religions in dialogue and discussion programs and through interfaith organizing from the grassroots level up, facilitated by government action and religious organizations declarations. 

As such, the EOIC would like to invite all religiously focused nations in Erene to discuss their beliefs, views, concerns, and aspirations with one another in a conference to be held in Medinah al-Islam, in shaa Allah. Hopefully this can also see the implementation of ethics and morality on the global scale. 

[i]Safiya bint Gharani Bakhtar
Director of Interfaith Affairs
EOIC[/i][/spoiler]
